column1: # The patches that each seed port applied in the check whose result seeds/builds.tsv gives, one row for each patch,
# in the order of the port's series file. sha256 is the hash of the bytes of the patch that the check applied.
# src/oss_verify/seeded_projects.py compares the series of each port with these rows. A port checked again gets its
# new row in seeds/builds.tsv and its rows here written again, from the series of that check.
